sql: WITH y2025 AS (SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_monthly AS e FORCE INDEX (`PRIMARY`) JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code WHERE c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'), y2024 AS (SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_monthly AS e FORCE INDEX (`PRIMARY`) JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code WHERE c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31') SELECT y2025.amount_usd - y2024.amount_usd AS export_difference_usd FROM y2025 CROSS JOIN y2024 ORDER BY export_difference_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

conclusion: 2025년 연간 수출액은 2024년 연간 수출액보다 256억 7,413만 달러(USD) 많습니다.

sql: WITH exports_2024 AS (SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_monthly AS e FORCE INDEX (`PRIMARY`) JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code WHERE c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), exports_2025 AS (SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_monthly AS e FORCE INDEX (`PRIMARY`) JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code WHERE c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') SELECT y24.amount_usd AS amount_2024_usd, y25.amount_usd AS amount_2025_usd, y25.amount_usd - y24.amount_usd AS difference_usd FROM exports_2024 AS y24 CROSS JOIN exports_2025 AS y25 LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN e.amount_usd END) AS amount_2024_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN e.amount_usd END) AS amount_2025_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN e.amount_usd END) - SUM(CASE WHEN e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN e.amount_usd END) AS difference_usd FROM export_monthly AS e JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND (e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' OR e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') LIMIT 1000

explanation: 수출액은 USD 기준이며, 2025년에서 2024년 수출액을 뺀 차이입니다.
